scope: Current production geometry owners and finite exceptions. Source/lifecycle contract, not native pixels or device acceptance.
rules: ReaderPageGeometry resolves authored facts; ReaderPageScaffold applies one resolved object and owns no resolver.
Each active body branch has one geometry owner. MainTabShell nonstandard branch composes chrome-only geometry and never resolves a second body.
measurementKey is a mounted/layout generation; only current keyed receipts define a changed header/footer budget. Environment revision alone does not certify entity lifecycle.
A rail replaces bottom navigation budget, never adds it twice. Full-height Scroll/List keeps its viewport and consumes internal insets.
Geometry/Scaffold/Standard roles and native ETS/pure TS boundary remain separate.

originalEightDirectResolverReview: Seven authored direct-host resolvers remain; MainTabShell's eighth former resolver is replaced by chrome-only composition. Standard and five branch-body consumers are included explicitly so no current resolver caller is omitted.

layoutFiles.reason: Index-only window capability policy; merging with frame/rendering geometry would make route composition depend on unrelated rendering roles.
SDK-native node measurement and coordinate conversion; cannot fold into pure Rect types without TS→ETS dependency. Search presentation consumes pure rect identities without SDK.
Native measured header shared by Scaffold and external ReaderLibrarySearchSurface. Folding into Scaffold duplicates the external host or changes consumer lifecycle.
Pure standard-page variants/inset policy and Area numeric conversion consumed by many independent chrome/pages; distinct from frame rendering and resolved geometry.
Pure window-space rect/owner/generation contract shared by navigation presentation, Index and search; distinct from page layout arithmetic.
Sole general page intent→geometry arithmetic plus explicit empty/chrome-only constructors; Scaffold consumes results and Standard authors inputs.
Navigation label/bar/bottom occupied-extent policy shared by navigation and many body owners; different consumer set and change cause from standard-page variants.
General bounded horizontal-frame algorithm used by dialogs, reading chrome and pages; cannot merge into page geometry without coupling non-page surfaces.
Native Scroll inset application only; Standard owns geometry/measurements and arbitrary callers retain scroller. Keep native application separate from pure shared Scroll/List offset model.
Reusable current-generation measurement store used by ten owners; no page-specific policy or SDK. Folding into one owner duplicates state or expands imports.
Measured standard-page composition shared by13 files; distinct from low-level Scaffold and pure resolver. Owns mounted viewport/measurement lifecycle.
Pure measured material border-box validation shared by panels/chrome/download/search; distinct from page content geometry and measurement storage.
Pure inset projection shared by native Scroll/List/Grid/directory and source-switch callers; cannot fold into its single Scroll renderer or page geometry without coupling consumers.
Native common layer ordering, safe-area, header/footer measurement dispatch and visibility; owns no business geometry resolution. Unique consumer/result boundary.
Actual ArkUI AttributeModifier classes shared by Scaffold/Header. Required ETS boundary; TypeScript re-export is forbidden by actual compiler semantics.
Pure resolved visual policy shared by all finite host categories and native modifiers. Keep policy DTO independent of SDK rendering.
